edits.find: and that the three heights 2, 3, 6 cm do **not** grow uniformly along it: the outer boundary of the image is therefore a **curve**, not a straight line.
edits.replace: and that its height grows steadily, by 1 cm for every 10 cm along the axis, from 2 cm at 50 cm through 3 cm at 60 cm to 6 cm at 90 cm. Every point of the sheet's top edge sends a ray parallel to the axis, which strikes the mirror at the same height and reflects through F, so the image of the whole top edge lies on that one reflected ray: the outer boundary of the image is a **straight line through F**, not a curve.
